text:
If you've got evening plans outside, keep half an eye on the sky through 10 or so, since there's still a scattered shower or rumble of thunder possible before things quiet down. Sunset's already come and gone under mostly cloudy skies, muggy and mild with lows dipping to around 64 overnight. The lake stays calm either way, waves a foot or less and wind out of the north under 10 knots, so nothing to worry about if you're near the water early.

Tomorrow's the reward: mostly sunny, high near 80, with the wind staying light out of the north. The Euro was the wet outlier on today's rain and it's the one to trust least here, everybody's models agree Tuesday stays dry, so plan on it. Good day for the lake or a long walk, with only a light breeze picking up by afternoon.
